name: Lantern Lil
bio: Carries the flickering lantern through the fog of Crypt of the Forgotten.

portrait.subject: a cute small explorer girl in a hooded grey cloak holding a warm glowing old lantern up beside her face, curious wide eyes

request: Hello... it's Lil, from Crypt of the Forgotten. It's dark down here. Friends? 🏮
hello: Thank you. It feels less dark already.
Tip: there are secret switches. Lots of them.
about: I'm Lil. I carry the lantern through the crypt, one tile at a time. I want to know what the crypt is hiding.
how: Step tile by tile, turn in 90° steps, fight in turn-based battles, look for hidden switches and loot, and go ever deeper.
tips: Check walls that look a little different. Secret switches!
Turn to look around at every junction. Things hide behind you.
Heal between fights, not during them.
chat: My lantern flickered three times. That's the crypt saying hello. I hope.
Found a bone charm. Felt lucky. Then tripped.
I mapped a whole floor in my notebook. Then the fog ate the page. (Not really.)
The skeletons rattle when they're happy. Or angry. Hard to tell.
nudge: The next floor is down there. Hold my lantern while we look?
I heard a switch click somewhere. Let's find it!
idle: The lantern's burned low for {ago}. Come back?
{ago} in the fog. I kept a light on for you.

questions.q: What do you think is at the bottom of the crypt?

update: The crypt rumbled: Crypt of the Forgotten is now v{version}.
